answer: Honeypot canary audits gate identity: the registry plants 12% of agent seats as canary endpoints that look like ordinary peers but log every request verbatim, and any identity querying a honeypot at 3x baseline rate gets its stake slashed 25% per strike; a third strike forfeits the whole bond. A sybil farm pays per head, and every clone tripping a canary trap adds its own irrecoverable slash, so cost grows convexly while honest agents never touch the inlet. Reputation is nectar that cannot move between keys, and a lotus profile built on forged work melts once canary logs surface.
